scope: Actual generate-content handler with intercepted Auth, RPC, Storage and Gemini HTTP
new_scenarios: Valid JSON at byte limit without Content-Length
Streamed overflow cancels before unread tail
False small Content-Length cannot bypass byte limit
Declared overflow cancels before body read
Malformed or empty provider parts return sanitized 502
UTF-8 split inside multibyte character stays valid
Non-OK HTTP response is cancelled without reading
Interrupted body returns sanitized 502 without retry

regression_evidence.before_fix: 7 of the new scenarios failed against the original entrypoint; oversize valid JSON returned 200 and malformed provider input returned 500.
regression_evidence.after_fix: All 30 scenarios passed; no provider retry or detail leak.

limits: Provider HTTP was intercepted. This report does not claim a new real Gemini request, final-domain email delivery, platform posting, or merchant integration.
